language.name: English
language.label: Language
app.title: Scan - document camera
install.prompt: Install Scan on this device for quick access.
start.title: Scan a document
start.description: Point your camera at a page on a plain surface. We'll find the edges automatically, straighten it, and let you save the crop.
start.cameraTooltip: Turn on your camera to scan a document.
camera.autoOn: Auto-capture is on. Click to disable.
camera.autoOff: Auto-capture is off. Click to enable.
camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and retry.
camera.notFound: No camera was found on this device.
camera.notReadable: The camera is already in use by another app.
camera.unavailable: Camera access isn't available in this browser.
camera.insecure: Camera access needs HTTPS (or localhost). Host this file over https:// and try again.
result.enhancedTooltip: Sharpen and improve the captured image.
result.originalTooltip: View the captured image without enhancement.
result.blackWhiteTooltip: Convert the document to black and white.
result.copyTooltip: Copy the captured image to your clipboard.
result.downloadTooltip: Save the document in the selected format.
result.shareTooltip: Share the document using your device's native share menu.
footer.local: runs locally in your browser - nothing is uploaded
